Well differentiated squamous cell carcinoma of right buccal mucosa, pT3N0M0, s/p right supraomohyoid neck dissection, wide excision, marginal mandibulectomy and reconstruction with free radial forearm flap and STSG (2026-07-22), margins negative, PNI(+), LVI(-), LN 0/24
現病史A 50-year-old male presented with right cheek swelling for 1 month, right buccal ulcer, and right upper gingival pain. Initial biopsy on 2026-06-03 showed squamous cell papilloma, but tumor excision on 2026-06-23 revealed well differentiated squamous cell carcinoma with involved margins. CT neck and PET on 2026-06-29 demonstrated a right buccal mass with suspicious cervical lymphadenopathy, and definitive surgery was subsequently performed on 2026-07-22
過去病史DM(+) Agoraphobia with panic disorder
癌指數SCC Ag： 1.95(2026-06-29)
病理2026-06-03： Oral cavity, right — squamous cell papilloma with papillomatosis and fibrovascular core.2026-06-23： Oral cavity, buccal, right — well differentiated squamous cell carcinoma with stromal invasion in papillomatous pattern. Tumor size indeterminate, DOI at least 2.0 mm. Margins involved by tumor. WPOI present. LVI(-), PNI(-). IHC: CK revealed stromal invasion, p53 focally positive, Ki-67 mildly increased.2026-07-22： Right buccal mucosa wide excision — well differentiated squamous cell carcinoma, 3.1 x 2 cm, thickness 20 mm, DOI 18 mm, invasion into muscularis propria. Bone invasion(-). PNI(+), LVI(-). Margins negative; closest deep soft tissue margin 1.5 mm. Right neck level I-III dissection: 0/24 LN involved. Mandible and right submandibular gland free of tumor. Stage: pT3N0.
檢查CT(2026-06-29)
4.2 cm enhancing lobulated soft tissue lesion in right buccal region. Multiple borderline enlarged bilateral upper jugular chain lymph nodes up to 1.2 cm in right level II. Preliminary imaging stage T3N1M0.PET-CT(2026-06-29)
Right buccal hypermetabolic lesion (3.5 x 1.7 cm, SUVmax 10.15→14.62), suggestive of oral cancer. FDG-avid right neck level IB and right level II LNs (largest 1.6 cm, SUVmax 2.03→3.58), suggestive of malignant LAPs; left level II & VI uptakes favor inflammatory LNs. No definite distant metastasis. FDG-PET staging: T3N≤2bM0, Stage IVA
治療Tumor excision(2026-06-23)Right SOHND + wide excision + marginal mandibulectomy + free radial forearm flap reconstruction(2026-07-22)
討論 Well-differentiated SCC pT3N0M0（DOI 18 mm、PNI(+)、margin 1.5 mm），決定分期，後續治療方針。

Well-differentiated squamous cell carcinoma of oral cavity, left lower gingivobuccal region with mandibular invasion, cT4aN0-2cM0, s/p Left segmental mandibulectomy with wide excision(2026-07-22, 彰秀), pT4a(2)N2c
現病史A 52-year-old male with a history of left buccal carcinoma pT3N2b, status post wide excision + left SOHND + right lower gum tumor wide excision (2023-06-13), and bilateral buccal moderate-to-severe dysplasia with verrucous tumor, status post right tumor wide excision + artificial skin graft + left fibrosis release (2025-04-09). He presented with teeth dropping for months and left oral ulcer for over 1 week (2026-07-16). Punch biopsy of the left lower gum on 2026-07-09 revealed well-differentiated squamous cell carcinoma with pearl formation and ulceration. CT and PET imaging demonstrated a left lower buccogingival lesion with mandibular invasion and equivocal right level I lymph node involvement. He was admitted on 2026-07-21 with plastic surgery consultation, and underwent composite resection + reconstruction plate ± neck dissection on 2026-07-22.
過去病史Left buccal cancer pT3N2b s/p wide excision + left SOHND + RT on 2023-06-13
病理2026-07-09： Oral cavity, left lower gum — well-differentiated squamous cell carcinoma with pearl formation and ulceration.2026-07-22： Left segmental mandibulectomy with wide excision — squamous cell carcinoma of left lower gum, moderately differentiated, 2.7 x 2.4 x 0.6 cm, DOI 6 mm, with cortical bone invasion of left mandible. LVI(+), PNI(-), WPOI 5. Anterior mandible bone cut margin and left (lateral) soft tissue margin involved by invasive carcinoma; deep margin uninvolved (1 mm), posterior bone cut margin uninvolved (12 mm). Right mouth floor resection — squamous cell carcinoma, poorly differentiated, size and margins not evaluable (fragmented specimen). Right neck level I: 1/3 LN metastasis (largest node 1.0 x 0.6 cm, largest deposit 0.7 x 0.5 cm, contralateral, ENE-); right neck level II 0/2; right submandibular gland unremarkable. Overall LN 1/5. Stage: pT4a(2)N2c (AJCC 8th edition)
檢查CT(2026-07-02)
CT neck with contrast: Mild thickening of left buccal mucosa and lower gingiva region with adjacent mandibular bony destruction. Postoperative changes over left buccal region. Subcentimeter lymph nodes in right submandibular region. Preliminary imaging stage T4aN0M0.PET-CT(2026-07-16)
FDG-PET/CT: Hypermetabolic lesion about 4.2 cm involving left lower buccogingival area with left mandibular invasion, SUVmax 12.7. Newly FDG-avid 1.1 cm right level I nodule, equivocal for regional LN metastasis. No distant metastasis. PET stage cT4aN0-2cM0.
討論影像及後續治療。
